beforeVisibleHistory.feedback: Compare precontrast with postcontrast signal rather than call every bright region enhancing. Then evaluate the corridor independently: a viable target does not justify contaminating a separate uninvolved compartment. Region R supplies both the supported enhancement information and a corridor through rectus femoris. This is a planning-report decision, not an additional biopsy order or proof of malignancy.
